recommendedTextbook.author: M. W. Anyakoha
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

subtopics: Trajectory of a projectile launched at an angle θ
Time of flight, maximum height, and horizontal range
Real-life applications: Sports, ballistics, and satellite launching
objectives: Derive formula for time of flight (2u sinθ / g)
Calculate maximum horizontal range when θ = 45°
Solve projectile motion problems neglecting air resistance

subtopics: Definition and conditions for SHM: a = -ω²x
Simple pendulum and loaded spiral spring
objectives: Determine acceleration due to gravity using simple pendulum period formula
Plot kinetic energy vs potential energy variation in SHM

topics.topic: Linear Momentum and Newton's Laws of Motion
subtopics: Principle of conservation of linear momentum
Elastic vs inelastic collisions and impulse of a force
objectives: State Newton's second law in terms of rate of change of momentum
Apply conservation of momentum to gun recoil and car collisions

subtopics: Wave properties: Reflection, refraction, diffraction, interference
objectives: Differentiate mechanical waves from electromagnetic radiation
Explain wavefront propagation and Doppler effect
Solve numerical problems using v = fλ
